notes:
GSTR-1 Tally Import fixes:
- Upload accepts both .zip (as downloaded from the portal) and plain .json — no need to unzip first.
- Multiple months can be selected at once and combine into one preview, same as GSTR-2B.
- Entry Type now correctly shows "Sales" instead of "Purchase" for GSTR-1 rows.
- "Supplier" column renamed to "Buyer" for GSTR-1, with a note explaining why it sometimes shows only the GSTIN (the portal's own GSTR-1 data doesn't include a buyer name).
- New ledgers for GSTR-1 correctly create under Sundry Debtors.

Other fixes:
- Ledger pickers in the Preview Grid are now always-editable inputs — no more double-click needed, and a ledger can be changed again anytime.
- Added pacing between vouchers sent to Tally (GST import, Bank Auto-Booking, Journal Entry) to reduce random Tally crashes during large batches.
